text:
Hi, I’m Mina Castellan. I have 5 years of experience in data analysis, dashboarding, and data cleanup, with strong skills in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, and data visualization.

I’d be glad to support your CRO agency with web research, lead generation, Google Sheets organization, and clear email drafting. In a recent project for Juniper & Ash Home, I built customer segments from Shopify order exports using recency, frequency, and spend in Google Sheets and Looker Studio, then fed them to the email tool. The top segment represented 9% of customers and 41% of revenue, and email revenue increased by 19%.

I’m comfortable with structured, detail-oriented work and can help keep information organized and actionable. I’m also willing to complete the test task and can start promptly.
